D/ IMP CARAVSIVS P F AV in RIC

A denarius of Carausius dating to the period AD 286 to 293. PAX AVG reverse. Unattributed mint. RIC V, Pt II, p. 525, no. 719var. This coin is not recorded with the obverse legend IMP CARAVSIVS P F AV in RIC, but therer are many examples in Sam Moorhead's corpus. This coin is included in Sam Moorhead's corpus for RIC
